entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. My order number is VF886-01.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see you have the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 23rd. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference. I just don't want it anymore.
I understand. I do see the order was delivered 34 days ago, which is outside our standard window for preference-based returns. Was there a specific reason for the delay in contacting us?
I had a medical emergency. I was in the hospital.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright now. Can you tell me a little more about what happened?
I had to have an unexpected surgery. Trying out a fitness gadget wasn't exactly my top priority. It's not like I was planning a deployment, it was an actual emergency.

I see, thank you for sharing that. I appreciate the context. Let me just double-check the policy for your item... one moment... Ah. Okay. Actually, I was mistaken. Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor is covered under our 10-day return policy. Since you're only on day 34, you are unfortunately outside the window. I can process this return for a full refund right now.
Oh. So you don't even need to hear about the hospital stay? Fine. I guess that was easier than I thought it would be.

No, sir, based on the purchase date, you're perfectly eligible. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days.
The email has just been sent. Your reference number for this call is 77419. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
